articles.summary: Proactive: Optima Health, Helium One, Buccaneer Energy, Rome Resources, Pantheon Resources, Valereum. Optima Health PLC (AIM:OPT, OTC:OHLTF, FRA:J3N) is buying PAM Healthcare for around £100 million in cash. The deal boosts scale in the UK and Ireland, cementing its position in an attractive and growing market. Helium One Global Ltd (AIM:HE1, OTCQB:HLOGF, FRA:H3O) reported a six-fold jump in flow rates at its ITW-1 well in Tanzania's southern Rukwa basin. The company will now launch a formal farmout process to bring in a partner for development. Buccaneer Energy Plc (AIM:BNE) says output doubled in an Organic Oil Recovery pilot at its Pine Mills field in Texas. It plans to roll out the recovery process across the field later this year. Rome Resources Plc (AIM:RMR) has extended high-grade tin mineralisation at its Kalayi project in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Fresh drilling shows multi-metre intercepts, with two rigs now operating on site. Pantheon Resources PLC (AIM:PANR, OTCQX:PTHRF) has started seismic reprocessing at its Kodiak project in Alaska. It is also preparing for a possible Theta West-2 appraisal well, subject to funding. Valereum PLC (AQSE:VLRM, FRA:6TJ) has signed an MOU with Integra Foundation on tokenised real estate assets.
